notes.title: The Cat Lady is updated to version 1.7
notes.notes:
Hi there! Today (January 10th) we have updated the standard (default) branch of The Cat Lady to Version 1.7. [b][u]Please see below for important notes about previously Saved Games.[/u][/b]

Your game will update automatically with a download of around 73mb. [b][u]This update currently applies to the Windows version only.[/u][/b] We hope to update the existing Linux version in due course.

Version 1.7 includes:

ːbadkittyː Quicksave (use F1-F4 keys) and Quickload (use F5-F8 keys)
ːbadkittyː The ability to delete Save Game slots from the Save/Load menu
ːbadkittyː Rebuilt through the latest version of AGS which allows for:
+ Better graphics options for HD resolution systems
+ Alt+Enter to switch between Fullscreen & Windowed Mode whilst playing
+ Increased memory cache, was max 100mb now max 512mb, which should help those who experiences slowdown issues
ːbadkittyː Updated steam_api.dll for those who have experienced an error on startup with "SetAchievement^1" error

[b]Recent customers and many others who have played recently or in the past will now have incompatible save games.

If you want to restore your old Save Games, you will need to jump back to version 1.5. This is very simple:

Right click on The Cat Lady in your Steam library, choose Properties and then select the Betas tab. From the drop down menu, select "Susan, version 1.5" and you will be on the Susan branch.[/b]

Anyone who has been using the Teacup branch may need to use the "testing" branch with the former Teacup version 1.6.

Whilst this update may cause a bit of interference to begin with, we're hopeful this new version 1.7 eliminates various issues for a number of players. 

As always, you can leave your feedback, any problems you find and such on our Steam forum: http://steamcommunity.com/app/253110/discussions/

Technical note: It's been rebuilt through AGS 3.4.1 which is a very recent version of the engine, therefore it may still have quirks. We're keeping an eye on player feedback in case someone notices something odd, ie faulty translations or GUI/interface that has moved to strange positions.

[i]Thank you for picking up [b]The Cat Lady[/b] recently in the winter sale! You may also be interested in the next game in the series, [b]Downfall[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/364390/ 

and keep an eye out for the upcoming 3rd game in this series [b]Lorelai[/b] 

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=787640447

expected Halloween 2018.

As always, thanks for playing The Cat Lady and supporting Harvester Games and Screen 7. Have an excellent 2018![/i] ːcatbloodː

Note: DRM-free editions at Humble/GOG etc will be updated to 1.7 in the coming weeks.

Screen 7
and on behalf of Harvester Games

notes.title: Version 1.6 update is available, but does not currently replace v1.5, because save games
notes.notes:
[b]Important info about a forthcoming update that will eventually affect all owners of this game here - you can access it now or find out how this update will affect you...don't worry...it's not as drastic as it sounds :)[/b]

Hi folks! Apologies about the issue just encountered with save games etc. We needed to look it over and come up with a quick solution. This announcement addresses those issues and what's in store for The Cat Lady:

Version 1.6 is available, which adds Quicksave & Quickload and the ability to delete Save slots within the game Load menu. 

Version 1.6 and previous versions are not compatible (save games will not work between them). For now, you can opt-in to the new version by going to Library > right click The Cat Lady > Properties > Betas and chose "Teacup - Version 2". 

For those who want to continue to access your old saves, for now you don't need to do anything, you will be on the current default branch or you can move yourself over using the instructions above to "Susan - Version 1.5". 

New players may want to use Teacup branch whilst current or former players may want for now to use the default or Susan branch. 

HOWEVER - We will be replacing the default branch with the new version in the coming weeks. At that point, you will need to switch over to the Susan branch if you want to continue to use old save games that worked in version 1.5. 

This way, through the use of branches here on Steam, that version will always be available to you here on Steam, but the default branch will then become version 1.6 as we feel it's important people have access to quicksave functions etc from the start of their experience with the game here.

Teacup branch is called Version 2... now that we know save games will have to break, we may as well go ahead and add autosave and fix a few other things, and call it Version 2 so that it doesn't get confused with the current versions.

So apologies for the recent interuption, version 1.6 (or Version 2 work in progress you might say) IS available but remember it's not going to load old saves. It is also going to replace version 1.5 in due course, for a better experience all round, though you will still be able to access and play the current version 1.5 here via the properties > beta menu, because we understand a lot of people have old saves etc.

Thank you for understanding!

Screen 7
& Harvester Games

PS. Oops didn't mean to outright delete the last announcement, thanks for your comments & feedback about the update problem. Thank you again to those who have recently purchased the game in the Steam summer sale, those who have left us feedback (of which we are trying to work into version 1.6/2) and everyone who continues to enjoy and support The Cat Lady!

notes.title: Small update to version 1.6
notes.notes:
You will notice a small update! Previous save games are compatible, however you will need to copy them over if you want to continue using them, please read the following:

[b]Please be aware that a new Saved Games folder will be created in C:\Users\[you]\Saved Games called [u]The Cat Lady[/u]. Just copy your save games from the original folder called [u]Cat Lady[/u] into the new one to access your previous saves in the new version. 

Also to note that files copied from the original folder ending in .045 thru to .050 in the filename will be overwritten by the quicksave slots once you start using the F1-F4 keys. Slots 49 & 50 are reserved for a possible future autosave function. To access any older saves with those file extensions, it should be possible to rename them, ie .030 and load them that way.[/b]

Version 1.6 includes Quicksave (using keys F1-F4) and Quickload (using F5-F8). 

You can also Delete previous save slots by going to the Load menu and pressing the Delete key when you have a save slot highlighted -- you will be prompted to confirm your choice. 

As always, you can still just copy + paste your save games elsewhere to keep the slots (45 manual save slots) free. 

This version of The Cat Lady uses a newer version of AGS engine so if you experience any issues please let us know, though we're quite confident it will continue to work without issue. The only remaining problem is that save slots are still limited to 45, our apologies - but we hope with quicksave/quickload and slot deletion within the game will help ease this issue.

Note: As a few new lines of text have been added, they are not currently translated, so you may encounter some English instructions if playing with a language enabled - we will update the translations in due course! We will also aim to bring version 1.6 to DRM-free (GOG, Humble, Screen 7 etc) customers very soon.

Thanks for playing The Cat Lady and your continued positive reviews (this update is a direct result of some of those, and thanks also if you recently bought it in the Steam Summer sale!)

regards, Screen 7
& Harvester Games

notes.notes:
Are you one of 40,000 The Cat Lady wishlisters? Now is your chance to grab the game. It's also a perfect opportunity for new players to experience as Harvester Games are soon to release Downfall, a brand new horror adventure (remake) game in the style of The Cat Lady.

notes.title: The Cat Lady Album DLC now available!
notes.notes:
You can now enjoy the powerful vocal tracks from The Cat Lady as DLC (MP3 format). 

[b]The Cat Lady - Music From The Video Game[/b] features tracks including Inside, Forever and Don't You Worry Love by Warmer, 5iah and Tears of Mars.

Your purchase helps support the artists and their talents, thank you!

12 songs are included. Once installed, they can be played via Library > Music or found in your SteamApps folder typically in TheCatLady > Soundtrack > Soundtrack*

The album is available elsewhere (iTunes etc) but you won't find it cheaper than here on Steam!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/395460

Please note - it's currently only available here in MP3 format, but if and when it's possible, we will be sure to include additional OGG files. 

* 25th Nov: This folder name is tentative on release and may be updated to read something a little more explanatory in the coming weeks.

Thanks and enjoy the music!

(And props to those who's great TCL fan-art we used for the album!)

If you have a problem installing the DLC please let us know here as this is our first attempt at creating a DLC, so there may be a quirk or two in the first week or so!

notes.title: Update game to Version 1.5
notes.notes:
A small update (5mb) is available that will bring your Steam copy to version 1.5.

This includes Russian, Portuguese, Hungarian & Finnish texts in the game (select from main menu > options or via setup/winsetup > language).

You can also select Polish but this language is not working fully yet.

[b]Please be aware these are all translations written by fans - a big thanks to them & their hard work and enthusiasm. As such there may be some small errors, which we will work to fix asap. The translators will be working from this update to smooth out their translations.[/b] So there may be some additional minor updates in case of spelling/grammar tweaks to the translations etc (and hopefully a fully working Polish language) over the next few weeks.

In the meantime please do try the game with these new texts and let us know if there are any major problems. Please note no graphics have been updated or changed, they remain in English.

We also made a slight modification to the translation file names, as we heard that some computers were having difficulties recognizing the filenames. No other changes have been made.

Version 1.5 is currently only available on Steam. An update for DRM-free copies is planned for the near future. We may try and add even more languages in the future. Further announcements will be posted of any new language updates.

Sorry if this has caused you any inconvenience but thanks for being patient whilst we get these additional languages working. regards!

PS. As always, if you have any major issues especially relating to this update, please make a post on the discussions board :)

Note to our kind translators who may wish to fix their TRS file: You may notice in tutorial section the words get obscured by the images of keyboard buttons etc. We need you to find shorter words as the graphics cannot be easily moved around. Try and use short words. This is noticeable in Russian version, where a long word at the beginning pushes the rest behind the graphics. In French, where the length of words are almost equal to the English counterpart, there is little problem here.

notes.title: Small update to Version 1.4
notes.notes:
We have made an update to your current version 1.4. 

1. Resizing of fonts to ensure text is not cut off during dialog sequences/options
2. Potential fix for a game-breaking bug in chapter 3*
3. Italian language added, first language to be added since release of ver 1.4
4. Soundtrack now included! Can be found in Library > Music 

This is currently a Steam only update. We have not released a DRM-free update or update to other providers at this point.

Please understand that over the next couple of days things may not be fully functional. We will of course work to rectify them. As far as we are aware, Save Games still work without any problems.

Please also be aware that WINSETUP has also been updated a little, with new Advanced Options. You may need to fiddle with the settings again if you see large borders, using Advanced > Show top & bottom borders etc.

Linux version should also be working ok - speech files are now back (some users found they were missing right after the update).

We intend to add more languages over the coming weeks, so you may experience some other very small updates occurring over the next month. 

Be aware that there is currently no update to the save/load system, so save slots are still limited (roughly 50). But we are working on this for a future update, to include a "Max slots" alert & the ability to delete slots. In the meantime, we strongly suggest newer players to move/delete old save game files (typically found in My Documents > My Saved Games > The Cat Lady)

Thanks for your patience and sorry for any inconvenience.

* Please let us know about any strange issues/bugs/dead-ends that happen in Chapter 3 or 4 (typically things relating to the shower) - or in relation to any of the other fixes in this update. Again we're sorry if this happens, please help us work through it & fix them!

[b]Bonus update:[/b] We have included the full OST as part of your Steam purchase. You'll find it in Library > Music (an update may be required).

We'd also like to add news of the sad passing of [url=http://www.adventuregamers.com/about/author/980]Astrid Beulink[/url] today who had been battling cancer. In 2013 she visited AdventureX (expo run by Screen 7 in the UK) and chose The Cat Lady when winning a prize in the end raffle and asked Michalski to sign it - it was the first time he had ever signed an autograph! Astrid's energy and enthusiasm for the adventure game scene, genre and The Cat Lady will be sorely missed, but will not be forgotten by myself, Michalski & the adventure game community. Rest in peace x

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - The Cat Lady, 10% off!
notes.notes:
The Cat Lady is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*
The Cat Lady follows Susan Ashworth, a lonely 40-year old on the verge of suicide. She has no family, no friends and no hope for a better future. One day she discovers that five strangers will come along and change everything...

By author Remigiusz Michalski (Harvester Games) this suspenseful psychological horror game features stylized artwork, a simple keyboard control method and English voice acting, plus a compelling, atmospheric 70 minute soundtrack by micAmic and featured artists Warmer, 5iah and Tears Of Mars.

The Cat Lady contains strong adult themes and is recommended only for players over 18.
*Offer ends December 11 at 10AM Pacific Time
